table_description: Fact table recording every item returned from web channel orders. At SF100TCL scale contains approximately 8 billion rows. Tracks refunded and returning customers separately, return reasons, and financial impact of each return.
use_cases: Web channel return rate by item or category
Return reason analysis for online orders
Refund method breakdown for web returns
Customer return behavior comparison across channels
data_quality_notes: WR_REFUNDED_CUSTOMER_SK is who gets the refund; WR_RETURNING_CUSTOMER_SK is who sends the item back — can differ.
WR_ORDER_NUMBER links to WEB_SALES.WS_ORDER_NUMBER for matching returns to original web orders.
WR_NET_LOSS is the key financial impact metric.
Sum of WR_REFUNDED_CASH + WR_REVERSED_CHARGE + WR_STORE_CREDIT represents total refund value.

table_columns.name: WR_RETURNED_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM. Return date. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: WR_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: WR_REFUNDED_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER. Customer receiving refund.

table_columns.name: WR_RETURNING_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER. Customer physically returning the item.

table_columns.name: WR_WEB_PAGE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to WEB_PAGE. Web page of original purchase.

table_columns.name: WR_REASON_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to REASON. Return reason code.

table_columns.name: WR_ORDER_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Original web order number. Links to WEB_SALES.WS_ORDER_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: WR_NET_LOSS
table_columns.description: Net financial loss from this web return.
